claims.statement: The package-level inheritance toggle selects or deselects inheritance from the linked repository; the interface recommends inheritance. The section label varies between Manage access and Inherited access according to current state. This is not the organization-wide automatic-inheritance toggle, verified state or authority to alter permissions.

The Docker registry deprecation note says replacement is future work for GHES and already superseded for FPT; GHEC receives a migration link but no explicit status clause in this fragment. Preserve the scope tension with the generic replacement fragment reviewed in issue 257 instead of asserting one universal present lifecycle status. The linked migration guide remains separate review work.
The GHES-only step identifies an Enable GitHub Packages checkbox. A navigation instruction is neither proof of effective enablement and prerequisites nor approval to change enterprise settings.

The pinned Maven warning restricts artifactId to lowercase letters, digits or hyphens and states uppercase artifact names produce HTTP 422. The external Maven naming guide is a source pointer, not reviewed by reference; this is not an executed upload or a generalized rule for every package client.

For GHEC, the pinned fragment limits Maven and Gradle support to public and private repository visibility, excluding internal repository visibility. This is not a GHES/FPT denial, actual repository classification or universal package visibility rule.
The step searches for and selects a package name to view it; navigation alone supplies no package inventory, permissions or successful observation receipt.
